images.description: Home before recording: Ask anything and the round record button (light)
Right after tapping record: Home stays, the bottom row is the recording bar with Undo (0:03) (light)
Four minutes in: the bar shows the running time and Wrap Up; the live card above shows the newest words (light)
After Undo: the bar is gone, no row was added, and a toast says Recording discarded (light)
